Questions from builders

I have no time to write. How much work is it for me?

Fifteen minutes a week. We write and publish, you read along and approve. Nothing goes online without your approval.

Do you know my trade?

We write based on what you tell us during onboarding and on what is already on your website. You read everything before it goes online, so nothing appears that is not right.

Does it also work if I only work in my own region?

Especially then. We write down where you work and where you do not, so AI knows for which questions your company is a good answer.

What does it cost?

From €99 per month, plus a one time setup fee of €195. The first term is six months, after that you cancel monthly. You start with a free baseline check.
